title: UX vs UI vs Web Design: Which Designer Do You Need?
h1: UX vs UI vs web design: which designer do you need?
description: The difference between UX design, UI design, web design and landing page design, what each designer delivers, and how to choose for a website or app.
intro: UX design, UI design and web design overlap, and many designers offer more than one. But they focus on different problems. UX is about how something works for the user, UI is about how it looks and feels on screen, and web design usually covers the visual design of a website, sometimes including the build. Knowing the difference helps you search for the right person and write a clearer brief.

faq.q: Does a UI designer build the website?
faq.a: Usually not. Most UI designers deliver designs; a developer builds them. Some web designers do both.

faq.q: Do I need UX research for a small website?
faq.a: Often not much. A clear structure and a few user tests can be enough.
